newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech real Nov construct output up 6.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech real Nov construct output up 6.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Construction output in the Czech Republic rose 6.5 percent in November in real terms compared with the same month in 1995, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Wednesday.
It added in a statement that construction output, in real terms, rose 5.6 percent in the first 11 months of the year over the same period in 1995.
CONSTRUCTION OUTPUT NOV/96 OCT/96 NOV/95 JAN-NOV/96
Note: Output figures are based on all sizes of companies. Wage figures are calculated only on the basis of companies with 25 or more employees.

The CSU said that the average wage in the construction sector in November was 11,619 crowns, up from 10,433 crowns in the same month last year. It added that the total number of employees in the sector dropped by 2.7 percent, year-on-year, to 207,000 workers.
